touchpoints: institutional website: home, research, programme and partnership call
proposal, call for funding and cooperation agreement: cover, body, table, signatures and annexes
technical or scientific report: cover, figures, notes, references and data
Forja digital product: evidence, permissions, lineage and trust states
infrastructure: dashboard, status, alerts and technical documentation
education and work: landing page, learning track, certificate and job-placement communication
partnership: co-branding with universities, government, companies and social organisations
verification seal: digital and print versions

brand_job.statement: Make a new private science and technology institution (ICT) recognised by government, academia, companies and learners as a single long-lived institution — not a list of services — that makes data, computing and knowledge circulate with criteria, sovereignty, proof and access.

audience.primary: Directors, board and funders; public bodies, ICTs, universities and funding agencies; researchers, engineers and data teams; companies and R&D&I partners; students and people in career transition; social projects and smaller organisations without adequate infrastructure.
audience.not_for: Buyers of generic body shopping, commodity hosting with no sovereignty requirement, showcase innovation, data marketplaces without governance, courses that measure success only by certificate, and anyone asking for data to circulate outside policy and trail.

offer_truth.statement: Four axes under one thesis: research and data platforms (R&D&I in data governance, AI, interoperability and federated systems), digital sovereignty and computing infrastructure, education and work with an employability commitment, and technology extension. R&D&I is the core activity; consulting and training sustain the mission and do not displace it. Forja is the anchor product for federated data circulation and processing.
offer_truth.basis: The Institute's master brief. The public qualification “ICT privada sem fins lucrativos” applies only when the legal constitution and statutory purpose actually support it (Lei 10.973/2004, art. 2º, V).

alternatives: informal status quo of copies, emails and manual approvals
foreign clouds and proprietary platforms with high lock-in
transformation or AI consultancies without infrastructure or institutional mandate
generalist ICTs positioned on broad innovation
not sharing data for regulatory or political fear

position.statement: Trust infrastructure for science and technology: the institution where technology passes through criteria, preserves sovereignty, leaves proof and reaches those who are usually left out.
position.basis: Brazilian peers (CESAR, Eldorado, RNP, EMBRAPII) occupy innovation, impact, transformation and network; review of their official websites on 2026-09-05.

right_to_win.statement: Institutional governance, federated data operation, own sovereign computing, R&D&I and an access mission under one roof, with criteria and evidence existing before and during circulation.
right_to_win.basis: Strategic hypothesis: market uniqueness has not been verified and must not be claimed publicly.

strategy.desired_meaning: Criteria before flow; sovereignty as collaboration under control, not isolation; proof instead of promise; access as capacity to work, not benevolence.

creative_direction.thesis: A malha vem antes do fluxo.
creative_direction.thesis_gloss: The mesh comes before the flow: rules, permission, origin and evidence exist before anything circulates.

principles.name: Criteria before gesture
principles.rule: Structure, rule, source, owner or limit appear before effect; whatever does not carry the idea is removed or kept quiet.

principles.name: One decision in Urucum
principles.rule: Per composition (page, screen, piece), at most one element in Urucum besides the centre of the symbol, which is part of the mark and does not count. Numerals, lists, headings, backgrounds, icons, running-text links and secondary chart series are never Urucum.

principles.name: Legible structure, not decorative network
principles.rule: Every line connects labelled entities and has a consequence; cells, trails and alignments replace dot clouds, circuits and networks.

principles.name: Every official piece leaves a record
principles.rule: Documents, certificates, reports, evidence screens and seals end in a legible record: what it is, version, date, owner and a verifiable identifier. A record without real data is not printed.

principles.name: People as agents
principles.rule: People appear researching, building, studying and working; never as passive recipients of benevolence.

creative_direction.signature: Nine bars, one decision: the symbol's centre bar reappears as the single decision mark of each piece, over a mesh of cells and rules that appears before the content; on covers, the symbol enters at field scale, cropped by the frame, with the centre always visible.
creative_direction.excludes: Green as a brand colour, illustrated leaves, fibres or basketry, a literal sieve, pseudo-Indigenous graphics, gradients, neon, glow, 3D, shields and padlocks as a sign of sovereignty, dot networks, blockchain or cybersecurity aesthetics, Urucum as a dominant field, the symbol repeated as a texture.

proofline.text: O que passa, passa com prova.
proofline.use: Only where the piece carries real governance, evidence, provenance or attestation.

principles.name: Proof before superlative
principles.rule: If a claim can show source, version, number, owner or condition, show it; if it cannot, reduce the claim.

principles.name: Concrete before abstract
principles.rule: Say what circulates, where it runs, who decides and what changes before talking about transformation.

principles.name: Brazilian without folklore
principles.rule: Clear, contemporary Portuguese; the origin of the name informs the method and never becomes pseudo-Indigenous vocabulary.

principles.name: Access without paternalism
principles.rule: Speak of capacity, work, autonomy and partnership; never of giving a voice, saving or benefiting.

principles.name: Promise tied to mechanism
principles.rule: Sovereign, verified, auditable and secure appear only when the mechanism behind them exists and can be named in the same piece.

tone_by_moment.institutional_and_calls: formal, economical, verifiable: mission, capacity, governance, evidence
tone_by_moment.product_and_operations: operational: short verbs, clear states, policy, origin and evidence labels
tone_by_moment.education_and_work: clear, demanding and respectful: learning goal and connection to work, no motivational promise
tone_by_moment.rdi_and_commercial: problem, hypothesis, scope, risk, capacity, delivery, proof
tone_by_moment.incident: timeline, known facts, facts still unknown, action taken, owner and next milestone

vocabulary.language_note: Lists are in Portuguese because they govern Portuguese copy.

boilerplates.short: O Instituto Urupema refina tecnologia em bem comum: pesquisa, infraestrutura e formação para que dados, computação e conhecimento circulem com critério, soberania e prova.
boilerplates.medium: O Instituto Urupema é uma instituição brasileira de pesquisa, desenvolvimento e inovação em dados, inteligência artificial e infraestrutura computacional. Desenvolve plataformas para que instituições cooperem com dados sem perder controle sobre eles, opera infraestrutura computacional própria para parceiros e projetos sociais, forma pessoas em tecnologia com compromisso de conexão com trabalho e transfere conhecimento a organizações públicas e privadas.

descriptors.institute: Pesquisa, infraestrutura e formação em dados, IA e computação.
descriptors.forja: Circulação e processamento federado de dados, com soberania e evidência.

verbal.seal_rule: “VERIFICADO · INSTITUTO URUPEMA” is a state, not an ornament: it appears only with the record that answers what was verified, by whom, when, in which version, under which rule and with which evidence.

palette.names_note: Colour and token display names (Palha, Areia, Tinta, Urucum and their derivatives) are the system's proper names in Portuguese and are not translated.
palette.behavior: Palha or white dominate the field; Tinta carries text, symbol and dark backgrounds; Areia separates and groups; Urucum appears once per composition as the decision. Functional colours exist for contrast and states and never represent the brand in communication.
rules: Text in Urucum uses Urucum texto, and only on Palha or white; on Areia, text is Tinta or Tinta reduzida.
An Areia rule separates only where space already separates; borders of fields, buttons and controls use Filete forte (3:1).
State colours exist only in product and operations, always with a label; never in institutional communication.
A Tinta background is a decision for a whole piece or a whole section, not a loose dark card.
In print, body pages use white paper; Palha is the field of screens and covers.
Urucum texto on Tinta only at 16 px or more with weight 500 or more: call to action, state or highlight, never body text.

families.name: Newsreader
families.use: headings, document openings, manifesto, quotations, stamp

families.name: Space Grotesk
families.use: body, interface, data, labels, record, name in the signature

families.name: Georgia and Arial
families.use: only in files edited by third parties without the brand families

roles.monumental: Newsreader, 96–200 px or 60–120 pt, weight 400, leading 0.92, optical size at maximum; one per piece, on covers and openings
roles.title: Newsreader, 28–40 px, weight 500, leading 1.1
roles.body: Space Grotesk, 16–19 px or 10–11 pt, weight 400, leading 1.5, 60–72 characters per line
roles.support: Space Grotesk, 14–15 px, weight 400, Tinta reduzida
roles.label: Space Grotesk, 11–13 px, weight 500, uppercase, tracking 0.08 em
roles.data: Space Grotesk with tabular figures, weight 400–500

rules: One scale jump per piece: the large heading is at least three times the body size.
Newsreader never in labels, tables or interface; Space Grotesk never in the opening heading of an institutional document.
Display headings are set by hand: line breaks by meaning, no widows, aligned to the visible edge.

production.criterion: SVG masters with outlined lettering, symbol geometry identical to the 285-unit master, and structural check with no font, raster or script; reproducible with ferramentas/gerar_logos.py.

logo.construction: 3 × 3 mesh of 81 × 34 bars with radius 17, alternating horizontal and vertical; the horizontal centre bar is Urucum. Cell = one third of the symbol side. In the signatures, the cap height of INSTITUTO equals the bar thickness (34), the x-height of urupema equals the bar length (81), the gap between the two lines equals the gap between bars (44.5), the distance from symbol to text is one bar length (81) in both signatures, and in the horizontal signature the text block, from cap top to the end of the descenders, is centred on the symbol's height.
logo.clear_space: One cell around the symbol or the signature; signature files already include it.

minimum_size.symbol: 16 px with the pixel-fitted favicon; 20 px with the master; 6 mm in print
minimum_size.horizontal_signature: symbol at least 44 px tall on screen or 8.5 mm in print (drawing about 160 px or 30 mm wide), so that INSTITUTO stays legible; below that, the symbol alone
minimum_size.vertical_signature: the same minimum symbol height: 44 px or 8.5 mm
minimum_size.stamp: 25 mm diameter; on screen from 160 px

logo.variants: Tinta and Urucum on light; Palha and Urucum on Tinta; one colour Tinta for stamp, blind embossing and engraving; one colour Palha on dark.
rules: Do not redraw, rotate, mirror, respace or reorder the bars; do not place letters inside the symbol.
The symbol may enter at field scale, cropped by the frame, once per piece, with the centre bar always whole and visible.
The symbol never becomes a pattern, texture or product icon.
The signature carries no fixed sector descriptor.

composition.grid: Mesh of cells: the usable width divides into 3, 6 or 12 columns; the minimum margin is one cell (96 px on screen; 18 mm on A4).
rules: Structure appears before content: Areia rules mark the cells and content occupies whole cells.

The decision bar has the proportion of the symbol's bar (2.4 : 1, rounded ends) and marks the piece's single decision: main call to action, current step, value that matters or destination section. Long rules are Tinta or Areia, never Urucum.
Controlled asymmetry: the heading takes the left column or the upper third; nothing is centred by habit.
Official pieces end in the record: labels in Space Grotesk uppercase and values in tabular figures, over a rule.
Documentary photography of real work: laboratory, machine room, field, research and classroom; hands, tools, screens, notebooks and cables before posed portraits.
People as researchers, technicians, students, professionals and partners.
Natural or neutral light, natural colour; no brand duotone or orange filter. Warmth comes from the graphic Urucum.
Impact pieces (results reports, accountability, press) use only real records of the project, person or place they speak about.
Uniform 1.5 px stroke at 24 px, ends and corners rounded in the bar's proportion, without copying the symbol.
Permission, origin, revocation and evidence states always carry a text label.
A padlock never represents sovereignty on its own.
Charts in Tinta and Areia tones; a single series or value in Urucum, the one the piece wants decided.
Lineage is drawn as a trail between labelled entities, with direction and date; never as a network of unlabelled nodes.
Every figure carries source, data version and date in its footer.
Bars enter along orthogonal axes and lock into the mesh; no elasticity or waves.
Structure appears before the content that crosses it; Urucum enters last, as the decision.
160–280 ms for micro-interactions; 400–700 ms for the animated signature.
With reduced motion, the final state appears immediately.
Instituto Urupema is the parent brand and the only source of institutional authority; the symbol belongs to it alone.

A product gets its own name when people outside the Institute operate or buy it directly and need to recognise it where the Institute does not appear; it always signs with the line “um produto do Instituto Urupema”.

A research, education or impact programme uses a descriptive name followed by “do Instituto Urupema”; it gets its own name only with a recurring external audience and a multi-year horizon, and never creates a symbol.
An internal technical component gets no public name; it is described by its function.

An initiative that does not answer the urupema test (raw technology goes in, passes through criteria, becomes value for those who need it) is a strategic exception and gets neither name nor signature.
In the trust layer (Forja, verification seal, records), participants appear as participants, in text, never as sponsors; commercial logos never accompany the seal.
cobranding: Institute leads: the Institute's signature first; partners after “com” or “em parceria com”, smaller.
Partner leads: the Institute's horizontal signature joins the partner row at the others' optical height, with one cell of clear space, without changing anyone's colours.
Parity: two signatures of the same optical height separated by a vertical rule the height of the symbol, with one cell on each side.

governance.source_of_truth: This repository: the brand book and its files in docs/ (published by GitHub Pages), this contract, and the tools that reproduce the masters. Reader-facing Portuguese wording of the book lives in ferramentas/livro-textos.pt-BR.json and changes together with this contract.
governance.owner: Brand owner appointed by the Institute's leadership; approves new applications and exceptions.
governance.change: Proposal, test in a real application, owner approval and new version: a file fix changes the third number; a new rule or file, the second; thesis, symbol, base palette, type families or architecture, the first, with leadership approval.
governance.exceptions: An exception is requested in writing, applies to one piece and is recorded; the same exception requested three times becomes a change proposal.
